{{MEinfobox
|name=Burn
|cg=Burn.png}}
{{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} is a status effect that deals bonus fixed damage to the afflicted unit. At the end of a turn, the unit with {{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} will take fixed damage equal to Burn Potency, and the Burn Count will be reduced by 1.

{{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} is linked to the {{Icons|Wrath}} Wrath Sin Affinity.

==Strengths & Weaknesses==
While {{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} is an easy Status Effect to use, as it is easy to stack and doesn't require micromanaging, it has a low damage cap due to Burn Potency having a max value of 99. This means that any given part can only take an additional 99 damage per turn, which many enemies with large HP bars can shrug off. {{StatusEffect|Dark Flame|d}} deals bonus {{Icons|Pride}}Pride damage in relation to {{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} Potency, allowing for a much higher single-turn damage cap, but this is restricted to [[Lobotomy E.G.O::Magic Bullet Outis]] and [[Magic Bullet Outis]] (both [[Walpurgis Night|Walpurgisnacht]] collectables), and even then Burn is still generally unable to deal as much damage as other fixed damage Status Effects (such as {{StatusEffect|Rupture|x}}[[Rupture]]) outside of [[Mirror Dungeon]]s.

To work around its low damage output, certain Identities can consume {{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} Count on targets to inflict varying amounts of {{Icons|Wrath}}Wrath damage, or even activate {{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} on targets by themselves using their skills without having to wait for the turn to end. 

<span>Inside the Mirror Dungeons, {{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} itself can reach a maximum output of '''180 damage per turn''', using E.G.O Gifts such as {{GiftTT|Searing Brass|25|t}} and {{GiftTT|Burning Fate|25|t}} (which raise its maximum Potency cap), and using status effects such as [[Great Trichiliocosm 三千大世界 Yi Sang]]'s {{StatusEffect|Shattered World|d}}, which multiply the damage dealt per turn.</span>

If the previous conditionals are fulfilled, {{StatusEffect|Dark Flame|d}} can reach an output of '''1050''' damage at Turn End without considering targets' Sin Resistances.

{{StatusEffect|Burn|d}} is most effective against enemies with small HP bars and Abnormalities with many parts. Burn damage, like all types of fixed damage, ignores damage reduction from buffs (like {{StatusEffect|Protection|b}}), level scaling, and enemy resistances or weaknesses. All Identities that focus on Burn infliction have at least 1 {{Icons|Wrath}}Wrath skill.

Burn is least effective against enemies with high HP and Abnormalities with one or two body parts.
